title: A Simple and Effective Temporal Grounding Pipeline for Basketball Broadcast Footage

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: Our method aligns a pre-labeled corpus of play-by-play annotations containing dense event annotations to video frames, enabling quick retrieval of labeled video segments.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Additionally, our unprocessed video corpus includes irrelevant moments (ad breaks, breaks in play) and unpredictable occlusions of key text regions.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: A Simple and Effective Temporal Grounding Pipeline for Basketball Broadcast Footage We present a reliable temporal grounding pipeline for video-to-analytic alignment of basketball broadcast footage.
